card.title: How To Replace iPhone Front Camera Without Loosing FACE ID

source.title: How To Replace iPhone Front Camera Without Loosing FACE ID

claims.statement: Only the dot projector and IR camera of TrueDepth are paired; if just the front camera module fails, it can be replaced by cutting open its metal cage without losing Face ID.
If the new front camera doesn't work, flashing an update often brings it up.

procedure: Confirm Face ID works and only the front camera fails.
Cut the shield over the front camera (no direct heat).
Reassemble; test camera, portrait, Face ID; flash an update if needed.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Heat or damage to the dot projector or IR camera kills Face ID.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
